build_url_function: build a URL from a label, base string, and end string by cleaning spaces and underscores
create_wikilink_extension: create a WikiLinkExtension instance with custom base_url, end_url, html_class, and build_url config options
register_wikilink_processor: register the WikiLinksInlineProcessor with the Markdown instance to convert double-bracket wikilinks to anchor tags
handle_wikilink_match: handle a regex match of a wikilink pattern and return an anchor element with the generated URL
make_extension_factory: use the makeExtension factory function to instantiate a WikiLinkExtension with keyword arguments
